name: CreateKey

parameters.help_en:
The description of the key.  
The description must be 0 to 8,192 characters in length
parameters.help_zh:
密钥的描述。  
长度为0~8192个字符
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en:
The purpose of the key. Valid values:  
ENCRYPT/DECRYPT: Data encryption and decryption.
SIGN/VERIFY: Digital signature generation and verification.

Default value: If the key supports signature generation and verification, the default value is SIGN/VERIFY. Otherwise, the default value is ENCRYPT/DECRYPT
parameters.help_zh:
密钥的用途。取值：  
ENCRYPT/DECRYPT：数据加密和解密。
SIGN/VERIFY：产生和验证数字签名。

默认值：如果密钥支持签名验签，默认值为SIGN/VERIFY，否则默认值为ENCRYPT/DECRYPT。
parameters.name: key_usage

parameters.help_en:
The source of the key material. Valid values:  
Aliyun_KMS (default): The key material is generated by Alibaba Cloud KMS.
EXTERNAL: The key material is imported by you.


The value is case-sensitive.
If you select EXTERNAL, you must import the key material. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/607841.html or https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/608827.html
parameters.help_zh:
密钥材料来源。取值：  
Aliyun_KMS（默认值）：密钥材料由阿里云KMS生成。
EXTERNAL：密钥材料由您自行导入。


请注意区分大小写。
如果选择EXTERNAL，您需要自行导入密钥材料。具体操作，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/607841.html或https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/608827.html
parameters.name: origin

parameters.help_en:
You do not need to specify this parameter. KMS will configure the appropriate protection settings for your key.

The protection level of the key. Valid values:  
SOFTWARE
HSM

If DKMSInstanceId is specified, this parameter does not take effect. If the instance is a software key management instance, the protection level is SOFTWARE. If the instance is a hardware key management instance, the protection level is HSM.
If DKMSInstanceId is not specified, we recommend that you do not specify this parameter and rely on KMS settings. If KMS has a managed HSM in the region, this parameter will be set to HSM. Otherwise, it is set to SOFTWARE. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/125803.html
parameters.help_zh:
您无需输入本参数，KMS会为您的密钥设置合适的保护级别。

密钥的保护级别，取值：  
SOFTWARE
HSM

如果指定了DKMSInstanceId：本参数输入后不生效。当实例为KMS软件密钥管理实例时，密钥保护级别为SOFTWARE；当实例为KMS硬件密钥管理实例时，密钥保护级别为HSM。
如果未指定DKMSInstanceId：建议您不输入，由KMS设置。当KMS在该地域有托管密码机时，本参数将设置HSM，否则为SOFTWARE。更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/125803.html
parameters.name: protection_level

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable automatic key rotation. Valid values:  
true: Enables automatic key rotation.
false (default): Disables automatic key rotation.

This parameter takes effect only when the key management type to which the key belongs supports automatic rotation. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2358146.html
parameters.help_zh:
是否开启密钥自动轮转。取值：  
true：开启
false（默认值）：不开启

仅当密钥所属的密钥管理类型支持自动轮转时，该参数值有效。具体内容，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2358146.html
parameters.name: enable_automatic_rotation

parameters.help_en:
The epoch for automatic rotation. The format is integer[unit], where integer indicates the time length and unit indicates the time unit. Valid units are d (days), h (hours), m (minutes), and s (seconds). Both 7d and 604800s indicate a 7-day epoch.

If the key is a default key, the value is 365 days.

If the key is a software-protected key, the value is 7 to 365 days.

If the key is a hardware-protected key, automatic rotation is not supported.

You must specify this parameter when EnableAutomaticRotation is set to true
parameters.help_zh:
自动轮转的时间周期。格式为integer[unit]，其中integer表示时间长度，unit表示时间单位。合法的unit单位为：d（天）、h（小时）、m（分钟）、s（秒）。7d或者604800s均表示7天的周期。

当密钥为默认密钥时，取值为365天。

当密钥为软件密钥时，取值为7~365天。

当密钥为硬件密钥时，不支持自动轮转。

当EnableAutomaticRotation参数为true时，必须设置此参数
parameters.name: rotation_interval

parameters.help_en:
The key specification. Valid values vary based on the key management type. For more information about key specifications, followed standards, and key algorithms, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/480161.html.

If you do not specify this parameter, the default key specification is Aliyun_AES_256
parameters.help_zh:
密钥规格，不同密钥管理类型的取值不同。关于密钥规格、遵循的标准、密钥算法的详细介绍，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/480161.html。

不输入参数值时，密钥规格默认为Aliyun_AES_256
parameters.name: key_spec

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID of the KMS instance.

You must specify this parameter when you create a key for a KMS instance. You do not need to specify this parameter when you create a default key (master key)
parameters.help_zh:
KMS实例的实例ID。

当您需要为KMS实例创建密钥时，必须指定本参数。当您需要创建默认密钥（主密钥）时，不需要指定本参数
parameters.name: dkms_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The tags to bind to the key. Each tag consists of a key-value pair, which includes a tag key and a tag value.

You can specify up to 20 tags. To specify multiple tags, use the following format: `[{"TagKey":"key1","TagValue":"value1"},{"TagKey":"key2","TagValue":"value2"},...]`.

Each tag key and tag value can be up to 128 characters in length and can contain uppercase and lowercase letters, digits, forward slashes (/), backslashes (), underscores (_), hyphens (-), periods (.), plus signs (+), equal signs (=), colons (:), and at signs (@).
A tag key cannot start with aliyun or acs:
parameters.help_zh:
为密钥绑定标签。每个标签由一个键值对（Key:Value）组成，包含标签键（Key）、标签值（Value）。

最多输入20个标签。输入多个标签时，格式为`[{"TagKey":"key1","TagValue":"value1"},{"TagKey":"key2","TagValue":"value2"},...]`。

每个标签键（Key）和每个标签值（Value）最多支持128个字符，可以包含英文大小写字母、数字、正斜线（/）、反斜线（\）、下划线（_）、短划线（-）、半角句号（.）、加号（+）、等于号（=）、半角冒号（:）、字符at（@）。
标签键不能以aliyun和acs:开头
parameters.name: tags
policy

parameters.help_en:
The storage location of hardware-protected key. This parameter takes effect only when DKMSInstanceId is set to the ID of a hardware key management instance. Valid values:
HsmInternal (default): Hardware-protected key is stored in the HSM and does not support rotation.
HsmEncryptedDatabase: Hardware-protected key is stored in the database.
Symmetric keys: Support rotation.
Asymmetric keys: Do not support rotation
parameters.help_zh:
密钥存储位置，仅当DKMSInstanceId输入的是KMS硬件密钥管理实例时生效。取值：
HsmInternal（默认）：密钥存储在密码机中，不支持轮转。
HsmEncryptedDatabase：密钥存储在数据库中。
对称密钥：支持轮转。
非对称密钥：不支持轮转
parameters.name: key_storage_mechanism

AutomaticRotation.description_en:
Indicates whether automatic key rotation is enabled. Valid values:

Enabled: Automatic rotation is in the enabling status.
Disabled: Automatic rotation is disabled.
Suspended: Automatic rotation is paused and will not execute
AutomaticRotation.description_zh:
是否开启了密钥自动轮转，取值：

Enabled：自动轮转处于开启状态。
Disabled：自动轮转处于未开启状态。
Suspended：自动轮转被暂停执行

CreationDate.description_en: The date and time when the key was created (UTC)
CreationDate.description_zh: 密钥创建的日期和时间（UTC）

DKMSInstanceId.description_en: The instance ID of the KMS instance

DeleteDate.description_en:
The scheduled deletion time of the key. For more information, see [ScheduleKeyDeletion]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/601417.html）.

This parameter is returned only when KeyState is set to PendingDeletion
DeleteDate.description_zh:
密钥的预计删除时间。 更多信息，请参见[ScheduleKeyDeletion]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/601417.html）。

仅当KeyState值为PendingDeletion时，才返回该参数

KeyId.description_en: The globally unique identifier of the key
KeyId.description_zh: 密钥的全局唯一标识符

KeyState.description_en:
The status of the key.  
For more information, see [Impact of customer master key (CMK) status on API calls]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/44211.html）
KeyState.description_zh:
密钥的状态。  
更多信息，请参见[用户主密钥的状态对API调用的影响]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/44211.html）

LastRotationDate.description_en:
The time of the last rotation (UTC).  
If the key is newly created, this value is the generation time of the initial key version
LastRotationDate.description_zh:
最近一次轮转的时间（UTC）。  
如果是新创建密钥，则为初始密钥版本生成时间

MaterialExpireTime.description_en:
The expiration time of the key material (UTC).  
If this value is empty, the key material does not expire
MaterialExpireTime.description_zh:
密钥材料的过期时间（UTC）。  
当该值为空时，表示密钥材料不会过期

NextRotationDate.description_en:
The time of the next key rotation.  

This value is returned only when the AutomaticRotation parameter is set to Enabled or Suspended
NextRotationDate.description_zh:
密钥下一次轮转的时间。  

仅当AutomaticRotation参数值为Enabled或Suspended时，才返回该值

Origin.description_en: The source of the key material

PrimaryKeyVersion.description_en: The identifier of the current primary version of the key
PrimaryKeyVersion.description_zh: 密钥的当前主版本标识符。

ProtectionLevel.description_en: The protection level of the key

RotationInterval.description_en:
The interval for automatic key rotation. The unit is seconds, and the format is an integer followed by the letter s. For example, a 7-day rotation interval is 604800s.

This value is returned only when the AutomaticRotation parameter is set to Enabled or Suspended
RotationInterval.description_zh:
密钥自动轮转的周期。单位为秒，格式为整数值后加上字符s。例如：7天的轮转周期为604800s。

仅当AutomaticRotation参数值为Enabled或Suspended时，才返回该值

RequestId.description_en: The ID of the request. It is a unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request and can be used for troubleshooting
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题
